info.title: Restaurant POS Backend API
info.description:
## Overview
Welcome to the **Restaurant POS Backend API** reference documentation. 
This interactive API console allows you to inspect routes, test live requests, and explore request/response schemas.

### Authentication
Protected routes require a JWT token passed in the Authorization header:
```http
Authorization: Bearer <your_jwt_token>
```

### Features Available
- **Authentication**: User registration, OTP code generation & verification, resend OTP, and secure login.
- **Users**: Current user profile management with role/identity context.
- **Organizations**: Multi-tenant business management, members, roles, slugs, and updates.
- **Organization Members**: Organization staff directory, email-based member addition, role assignment, status changes, and access management.
- **Roles**: Standard POS staff roles (owner, manager, cashier, waiter, chef, accountant) and custom organization roles with fine-grained access control.
- **Restaurants**: Multi-location dining branches, unique organization slugs, timezones, currencies, and operational status.
- **Restaurant Members / Employees**: Multi-location employee management, unique employee codes, branch-level role assignments, status management, and join tracking.
- **Employee Shifts**: Open/close register shifts, cash drawer floats, cash reconciliation, duration calculation, timezone-aware operational tracking, and shift concurrency guards.
- **Table Sections**: Dining area layout sections (Main Hall, VIP, Patio, Rooftop), display sort ordering, and dining table grouping.
- **Restaurant Tables**: Dining room table management, seating capacity, live table operational status (available, occupied, reserved, maintenance), section association, and digital QR code ordering links.
- **Customers**: Guest profile management, restaurant-scoped phone search, contact details, notes, active status, and loyalty points tracking.
- **Customer Addresses**: Multi-address management for customer delivery orders, labels (Home, Office), and single-default address transactional switching.
- **Orders**: Dine-in, takeaway, and delivery order processing, unique sequential order number generation, table occupancy conflict guards, status transition state machine, and financial calculation integrity.
- **POS Entities**: Extensible architecture for Menus and Payments.
